$comment: LOOMFALL canonical color system — 'Light Through the Warp'. Every color behaves like light passing through taut thread: it enters gold and leaves violet. One luminous axis (Everthread gold #F2C14E -> Void Ink #14101F) governs brand, UI, and world. Three laws: (1) hue-shift-don't-darken — shadows rotate toward the cool ~250deg violet anchor holding saturation, highlights toward the warm ~50deg gold anchor shedding it; saturation is a hump peaking in the midtones. (2) Nothing is ever gray — every neutral carries a 3-8% saturation bias, warm ecru in the lights, violet in the darks. (3) Realm hues are oaths — saturated ember orange (hue 8-42) appears ONLY in the Cinderloom; saturated cold cyan (hue 165-205) appears ONLY in Nevermend; the Warpwold owns green-through-gold and keeps day-sky blues at hue >=208. Grafted from the dyed-thread school: the primary CTA is the gold thread itself (Everthread fill, void-ink label), tooltips stay dark loom-room cards in both themes, and Everthread gold bookends the journey (first stitch at the unfinished_hem accent; the Last Selvage stays entropy-cold cyan). All ui.pairs are WCAG 2.1 verified by scratchpad/wcag_check.py. Never rely on hue alone: warn=fray-knot triangle, error=frayed-X, success=stitch-check, info=droplet glyphs, each with a >=0.15 luminance edge vs its surface.

primary.name: Everthread Gold
primary.role: The First Thread. Logo stroke, primary CTA fill, focus rings, knotlight glow, the one warm thing in Nevermend.

secondary.name: Duskwarp Violet
secondary.role: The cloth at dusk. Secondary buttons, panels, light-theme hover ink.

void.name: Void Ink
void.role: Violet-biased near-black (never pure black). Dark-theme root, hero backgrounds, the dark every thread is drawn through.

muslin.name: Unbleached Muslin
muslin.role: Warm off-white (never pure white). Body text on dark; light-theme root at #EFE9DB — the undyed cloth.

warp_green.role: Warpwold identity green; growth, grass LUT anchor.

dye_indigo.role: Dreamdye indigo; info/water family, dyewater band. Hue ~226 — never trespasses on Nevermend cyan.

madder.role: Dye-band red, decorative; kept distinct from functional error red.

knotlight.role: Captured-flame glow for anchor/waypoint icons; always haloed against dark.

hemstone_cyan.role: Cold gleam of the finished edge. Nevermend-exclusive family with #DDF3F0.

forbidden.ember_outside_cinderloom: hue 8-42 at S>0.62, V>0.55 is Cinderloom-exclusive
forbidden.pure_gray_black_white: all neutrals carry 3-8% saturation bias; #000000/#FFFFFF only as sub-1% pixel accents

pairs.usage: links on panel (dark); underline always on
primary CTA — void-ink label on Everthread gold
primary CTA hover — brighten bg, deepen label (>=5% pixel diff)
info/water text + droplet glyph (dark); hue ~213, not cyan
HUD values; over world, 1px #14101F outline carries contrast
focus ring vs root (dark); non-text indicator
links (light) — Everthread darkened to ochre; underline always on
primary CTA — same gold thread in both themes
tooltip — inverts to dark loom-room card in light theme
focus ring vs root (light); non-text indicator

warpwold.notes: The lush woven surface. Hue path 227->144->122->98->83->63->51->47: cool violet-blue understitch shadow rotating through canon grass greens (132->85) into dawn gold ~50. W3 #5F8A46 is the identity midtone and saturation peak (grass albedo, foliage LUT anchor); W0 is night ambient/cave mouths; W7 is tiny sky-facing highlights only. Per-texture ramps sample 4-5 adjacent stops (grass = W1-W5) keeping value spread ~0.35 and albedo in the 0.25-0.85 band. Sky #9FC1E8 day zenith (hue ~215, never cyan), lerping to W6 at dawn/dusk and #2C3247 at night; base fog #DAE4EC. Lighting: warm sun multiply (1.05, 1.00, 0.88) vs cool shade multiply (0.58, 0.63, 0.82) — this pair IS the realm's look.

cinderloom.notes: The ember and ash making-below. Hue path 13->17->12->10->16->23->35->42 (canon lava path 6->48: red heart to amber heat). C4 #C24A20 is the saturation peak (live ember/glowing warp-lines); C0-C1 = ash vault and spent skein; C7 = fire cores and sparks only (tiny accents). Sky is #191210 smoke vault — no sky, no night; the ceiling is darkness lit from below. Fog #7E2F18 ember haze near fire, #3A2E24 cool tallow haze in the vaults. Lighting inverts: ember UPLIGHT multiply (1.10, 0.74, 0.46) on downward faces, upward faces fall to C0-C1. OATH: every saturated orange in the game lives in this ramp — seeing ember means you are in, or looking into, the Cinderloom.

nevermend.notes: The frayed void past the last selvage. Hue path 250->250->251->255->251->243->194->172: violet-black holding at the cool anchor, breaking into cold cyan gleam only at the top. N3 #453672 is the main frayed-island terrain (saturation shoulder); N0 is the one legal near-black — it is absence, not surface; N6 is the cyan threshold (needle glints, fray edges, stitch-light); N7 = hemstone pale, the finished rim. Sky #0A0812->#131022 starless; fog #171327 deep / #2E2846 among frays / #3C355C at the selvage. Lighting: flat cold hemstone key multiply (0.72, 0.86, 0.90) from nowhere in particular; the player's Everthread gold #F2C14E reads as the only warm thing in the realm — that contrast is the emotional design. OATH: every saturated cold cyan lives here — cyan means you are beyond the hem.

sennmeadows.notes: Warm starting country; accent = embroidered flower-knots (madder-pink, luminance pop, never hue-only).

thrumwood.notes: Green-cast forest fog; secondary = braided-cord bark; accent = dyed-light gold patches through the brocade canopy (hue 46, clear of the ember band).

muslin_fens.notes: Fog is the biome: dense pale gauze desaturates everything; accent = silence-moths (pale violet-white, brightest value in scene).

understitch_downs.notes: Violet-shifted sky/fog signal ghost terrain; secondary = phantom-ridge violet-gray; accent = understitch echoes rendered at 30-40% opacity offsets.

warpspine_reach.notes: Stone at canon hue 216 / S~7%; secondary = raw cotton snow (warm-white, never pure); accent = exposed ore seams in gold (hue 45).

the_frostlace.notes: Brittle white lacework over blue-violet frost — deliberately blue (hue ~215-225), NOT cyan, so it cannot be mistaken for Nevermend; lethally quiet = lowest-saturation cold biome.

bleachlands.notes: The drained page: warm ecru grays at exactly the 3-8% saturation floor (never S=0); accent = the last faint stain of dreamdye, a bruised violet.

dyewater_coast.notes: Sand at canon hue 46; accent = indigo dye-band; sea renders in unmixed hard-edged bands indigo #35509E / madder #B03A52 / weld #D9B93A — banding carries value steps too, never hue alone.

unfinished_hem.notes: Detail thins to sketch: terrain fades toward raw-canvas secondary; fog is blank-page pale. Accent = Everthread gold, the one finished stitch on the frontier — the brand primary's first bookend.

emberwarp.notes: Red-hot warp-lines (feature) over black ash; accent = molten thread-river amber; no shade, no night — the fog itself glows.

ashskein_wastes.notes: Spent-yarn dunes in warm ash grays (7-8% sat bias); feature = ash-glass with a violet sheen hiding drops; accent = slagmoth ember-glints — the danger telegraph.

tallow_vaults.notes: Wax-cream tallowstone cathedrals; the inversion biome: accent is cool violet-slate — the underworld's ONLY cool shadows, a visible relief from ember heat.

cinderspindle_forges.notes: Feature = rotating ember-spindles; accent = white-fire pit cores (near-white warm, tiny-area exception); hottest palette in the game — Molthkin's arena pushes C6-C7 coverage.

the_fraying.notes: Half-unravelled tapestry islands; feature = desaturated ghost-green, the memory of the meadow each island used to be; accent = cold cyan fray-edges (cyan begins here).

loosened_dark.notes: Genuine unspun nothing; terrain = only what you stitch; accent = saturated stitch-light cyan marking your own placed path — the highest-chroma cyan in the game, readable at max fog.

last_selvage.notes: The shining finished rim: palest terrain in the game under the darkest sky; accent = the Last Needle's cold cyan-silver gleam — deliberately NOT gold. Gold is the player's hope; cyan-cold is entropy's finish.

packVariants.$comment: This is the DEFAULT pack palette. smooth-cartoon derives by S x1.25 with ramp stops 0-1 and 6-7 merged (fewer bands, soft); gritty derives by S x0.65 with value contrast stretched x1.3 on the same hue anchors — pack identity stays measurably distinct per the UX rubric (cartoon mean-S >=1.2x default; gritty mean-S <=0.7x + contrast >=1.3x).
